lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: She's asking you if we're really underwater!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You... you were lying to us?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Talk, damn you! Were you lying to us?!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Why would this time be any different?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Feigning kindness, pretending to be benevolent! Telling me I could trust you... not again...!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Save it. I don't need your excuses.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: and I don't care whether I drown.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I can't stay in a place like this any longer. I'm leaving!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No! It's dangerous to go out now!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Do you really expect me to believe you?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Gluttony is a colossal Rapture, and we're inside its throat. Going out now would mean certain death.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: What in the world are you talking about? Are you saying I was eaten by a Rapture?
Little Mermaid frantically nods her head.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: So calm down and listen to me.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Th-there's no way. I c-couldn't have been eaten by a Rapture!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Does... does that mean I'm going to die?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You're not going to die. No matter what, I'll...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Shut up! I don't trust a single word you say!
Little Mermaid reaches out to Mori.
Mori swings her bag to shake off Little Mermaid.
An assortment of items come flying out of the opening of the bag:
an intrenching tool, military rations, a first aid kit, a compass... and a black box.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: You're Mori from the Incubator Squad, yes?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Jien.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Goodness, here I am trying to exchange greetings, and you're dispensing with all formalities.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Don't you think that's rather rude?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I dislike beating around the bush just as much as you.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Th-thank you for not getting mad...

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I owe you an apology. I'll admit I was a bit cavalier, considering that this mission will decide whether you get disposed of or not.
Jien hands Mori a black box.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: A calling signal?! Doesn't that mean Raptures...

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Be careful not to drop it.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: If that box takes a tumble and breaks, it'll emit a calling signal straight away.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Why are you giving me this?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: You're going to follow someone up to the surface.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: When you've gotten far enough from the Ark,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: you'll throw this box behind her,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: which will automatically activate the calling signal.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Then, all you have to do is report back to me on how she reacts.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: But why? Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: When something that's a fusion of a Rapture and a Nikke hears the calling signal,

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: will her Rapture instincts awaken and move her to tear apart her beloved Nikke companion?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Or will her rational Nikke side win out and have her tear herself apart, having become a Rapture?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Yes. Not too long ago, I managed to create such a thing.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Haha, no need to force yourself to agree.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I know very well how volatile such an entity might be.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: So let's keep this our little secret, okay?
Jien takes Mori's shaking hands in hers.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: What are you so frightened of?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: At this rate, you might end up breaking this box right here and now inside the Ark.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: If that happens, forget about it being a question whether or not you'll be scrapped. You'll be branded a traitor and executed immediately.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: You just need to do one thing.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: is tell me what they choose.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: I'll see that you're permanently removed from the disposal list.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: When do I need to do this?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Your scheduled scrap date is 2 months from now, correct?

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Report your findings to me before your scrap date.

lines.speaker: jien
lines.text: Contact me within 2 months with a report.
Mori desperately reaches out towards the black box, but...
The black box falls onto the floor and shatters.
Raptures start rushing toward the transparent barrier.
The Rapture horde collectively slams against the barrier,
desperately trying to get closer to the calling signal.
A hole forms in the transparent barrier.
A mixture of silver liquid and sea water pours in from the opening.
Anything which makes contact with the silver liquid immediately turns black.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We need to plug up the hole!
Little Mermaid stretches out her hands and sends water droplets towards the gap.
Despite her efforts, the water droplets are unable to plug up all the cracks, and the silver liquid continues to seep through.
Some of the droplets make contact with the AA Pillar.
In an instant, the AA Pillar begins to turn silver.
The Little Mermaid reaches out, sending a mass of bubbles that wrap around the AA Pillar, which is rapidly turning into silver liquid.
The bubbles and silver liquid clash and coalesce violently, as if each is attempting to consume the other.
Gradually, the bubbles turn a violet hue.
Yuni's eyes start to glow red.
Mihara looks at Yuni's eyes, which have turned red.
Despite her seeming to have lost her mind, tears stream down from Yuni's eyes.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Let go of her! Please, let go!
Mori clings desperately to Yuni's arm.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Get a hold of yourself, Yuni! You're going to kill Mihara!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I said, snap out of it!
Little Mermaid and Yuni lock eyes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Do you remember when you first fell in here?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: What you said inside the bubble.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes, now it's your turn, Yuni. Because you're a Nikke.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: A Nikke who loves Mihara, and who wants to save her.
The red glow starts to fade from Yuni's eyes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You are a Nikke, not a Rapture.
As Yuni's eyes return to normal, she loosens her grip.
Mori's feet stumble upon the remnants of the broken box.
In the throes of panic and desperation, Mori had forgotten her sins.
Now, faced with the evidence of her error, a wave of guilt crashes over her.
To Mori, it sounds like a scream.
It feels as if Yuni's wailing cries are directed towards her, reprimanding her and telling her that she must reckon with her sins.
Yuni's mask is stained with tears.
